transcript.text: Alright everyone, thanks for gathering. As we all know, the trailer is picture-locked at 60 seconds and going up this week, so we need to finalize the music clearance today. Our shortlist is down to 'Static Bloom' and 'Neon Weather,' and this cut will be running both online and in cinema pre-roll. Before I make the final call and record the delivery package, I want to hear from each of you per our standard clearance huddle — rights, label, editorial, and festival-submissions leads, please go ahead and report your findings. Who wants to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I can start on the rights side. I reviewed the executed publishing license for 'Static Bloom' yesterday. The composition may be used in the official trailer only for a cue of no more than 42 seconds, and the exact credit must read 'Written by Celia Voss.' I completed the review but haven't yet entered the terms in the clearance tracker, so I want to make sure everyone hears it here first.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: On the label side, I need to share what I've confirmed with the master-rights owner for 'Static Bloom.' Only the instrumental master is cleared for this trailer, on a non-exclusive basis, limited to the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. The vocal master is excluded, and any territory outside those three is not cleared. I should note that this confirmation is still in my email — I haven't yet moved it into the shared licensing folder, so you're all hearing it here first.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: On the editorial side, I need to flag something critical about the picture lock. I checked the locked picture and confirmed that the music cue begins at exactly 00:18 and runs for exactly 42 seconds. Changing either of those timings would require reopening the approved picture lock, which I have not done — and I haven't circulated a revised music note because of that. So the 42-second cue duration is a hard constraint tied to the current picture lock.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: On the festival-submissions side, I need to flag a new requirement. I confirmed with the festival upload vendor this morning that the trailer package must include a 48 kHz, 24-bit stereo WAV of the cleared instrumental and a completed cue sheet before the file can be accepted. The vendor added this requirement to the submission portal this morning. I have not yet updated the production checklist, so you're all hearing it here first.
transcript.speaker: A5
